newsitem.title: USA: Fashion designer Gianni Versace killed in Miami.
newsitem.headline: Fashion designer Gianni Versace killed in Miami.

text.p: World-renowned fashion designer Gianni Versace was shot and killed on Tuesday outside his mansion on Miami Beach, a hospital source said.
"He was shot and he is dead," the source at Jackson Memorial Hospital told Reuters.

Miami Beach police spokesman Al Boza, speaking outside the luxurious mansion on Miami Beach's fashionable Ocean Drive, said a white man aged about 25 was being sought in the shooting, which took place at about 9 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT).
